mapper.select: select i.item_id, i.curriculum_id, i.course_id, coalesce(nullif(i.course_code, ''), c.code) as course_code, i.requirement_type, i.section, i.stream, i.min_units, i.sort_order, i.create_by, i.create_time, coalesce(nullif(c.title_zh, ''), c.title_en) as course_title, c.credits as course_units from edu_curriculum_item i left join edu_course c on c.course_id = i.course_id where i.curriculum_id = #{curriculumId} order by i.sort_order, i.item_id
mapper.insert:
insert into edu_curriculum_item (curriculum_id, course_id, course_code, requirement_type, section, stream, min_units, sort_order, create_by, create_time) values
(#{item.curriculumId}, #{item.courseId}, #{item.courseCode}, #{item.requirementType}, #{item.section}, #{item.stream}, #{item.minUnits}, #{item.sortOrder}, #{item.createBy}, sysdate())
mapper.select: select count(1) from edu_curriculum_item where curriculum_id = #{curriculumId}
